name: Ant & Dec's Saturday Night Takeaway
description: A gameshow hosted by Ant and Dec filled with stunts, sketches, and special guest appearances.

videos.title: Who Shot Simon Cowell?
videos.overview: When Simon Cowell is shot at his celebrity-filled birthday party, Ant & Dec are accused of the crime and forced to go on the run, with hilarious consequences. With the authorities hot on their trails, the boys investigate to find the real culprit, in order to clear their name and reveal who really shot Simon Cowell.

videos.title: The Missing Crown Jewels
videos.overview: Ant & Dec join "The Honoured" - a secret service staffed by celebrities with honours. When the Crown Jewels are stolen on Ant & Dec's watch, their new boss Joanna Lumley tasks the boys with tracking down the mysterious villain known as Maskface before they sit on the throne and become the reigning monarch.

videos.title: Saturday Knight Takeaway
videos.overview: Ant & Dec tackle their second mission for "The Honoured" by finding out who is kidnapping its members, including the organisations' leader.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The Geordie duo return with the entertainment show, featuring undercover pranks, sketches, famous guests and competitions. This Morning's Eamonn Holmes and Ruth Langsford take part in I'm a Celebrity Get Out of Me Ear, Little Ant and Dec mix with Hollywood A-listers at the Baftas and Michael Buble provides the voiceover and end-of-show performance. Plus, Ashley Roberts sends the presenters to the very edge in Ant v Dec, and an audience member plays to win the items advertised in one of last week's commercial breaks.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Hot-tempered chef Gordon Ramsay becomes the target of an audacious stunt as Ant and Dec go undercover in Los Angeles, and Little Ant and Dec meet Mr Selfridge star Jeremy Piven. Comedienne Sarah Millican lends her distinctive tones to the voiceover booth and dance troupe Diversity take part in the End of the Show Show. Plus, an unsuspecting member of the public is launched 150ft into the air in new game Place on the Plane and there's a chance for someone in the studio audience to win the items advertised in one of last week's commercial breaks

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: The Geordie duo go undercover to give antiques expert David Dickinson the surprise of his life, voyage into the unknown in another round of Ant v Dec and give one lucky member of the studio audience the chance to win the contents of a commercial break. Keith Lemon brings mayhem to the studio as the celebrity guest announcer, the Supercomputer dishes out prizes in Norwich and McBusted perform with some special guests in the End Of The Show Show

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The Geordie duo turn the tables on Holly Willoughby when they go undercover as guests on Surprise Surprise, and also give some unsuspecting members of the public the shock of their lives. The cast of West End musical The Commitments gets involved in a St Patrick's Day-themed End of the Show Show and the Supercomputer causes mayhem in Belfast. Plus, a chance for someone in the studio audience to win the items advertised in one of last week's commercial breaks

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: The Geordie duo take control of Christine Bleakley in I'm a Celebrity Get Out of Me Ear, and Little Ant and Dec meet Samuel L Jackson and Scarlett Johansson, who star in new film Captain America: The Winter Soldier. The Supercomputer is in Sheffield, and an unsuspecting member of the public is catapulted 150ft into the air as they play for their Place on the Plane. Plus, Swiss performers the Top Secret Drum Corps take part in the End of the Show Show. The Muppets are this week's guest announcers in the studio

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: The Geordie duo take control of Peter Andre in I'm a Celebrity Get Out of Me Ear and compete in another head-to-head contest. Plus, Little Ant and Dec talk politics with London Mayor Boris Johnson, the Supercomputer dishes out prizes in Plymouth and, as usual, there's a chance for an audience member to win the items advertised in one of last week's commercial breaks

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: The Geordie duo go head to head in their most daring round of Ant v Dec to date as the entertainment show goes out with a bang, and Robbie Williams joins in the fun, taking part in a performance at the end of the programme. Another mystery celebrity features in the live sing-along, all the winners of Place on the Plane jet off to Florida, and a member of the studio audience plays to win the items advertised in one of last week's commercial breaks

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Ant and Dec are back with the brand new series. Ed Sheeran performs live in the studio, the pair make a dummy out of Olly Murs and Ashley Roberts joins them for Ant v Dec.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: The Geordie duo take control of TV presenter Richard Madeley in I'm a Celebrity Get Out of Me Ear!, the Supercomputer is in Edinburgh, where locals use hidden talents to win flights to New York, and one lucky member of the studio audience plays to win the contents of a commercial break. Plus, more fun and games, star guests and musical performances

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: The Geordie duo take control of daytime talk-show host Jeremy Kyle in I'm a Celebrity Get Out of Me Ear!, and Little Ant and Dec meet pop superstars Take That. The Supercomputer heads to Southampton, where members of the public try to win a holiday to New York using hidden talents, and there's another high-stakes round of Ant v Dec overseen by Ashley Roberts, as well as an all-singing, all-dancing End of the Show Show. Plus, a chance for a member of the studio audience to win the contents of a commercial break. Rob Brydon is this week's celebrity guest announcer

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The Geordie duo go head to head in this week's high-stakes round of Ant v Dec overseen by Ashley Roberts, Little Ant and Dec cause more mayhem and there's a spectacular End of the Show Show with tango masters Vincent Simone and Flavia Cacace. The Supercomputer hits the road again, and another member of the studio audience plays to win the contents of a commercial break

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Stephen Mulhern finds himself at the mercy of the Geordie duo as they once again go undercover, Ashley Roberts oversees this week's round of Ant v Dec, and the guest announcer is this year's Oscars host Neil Patrick Harris, getting in some practice before he takes the reins of the American version of Saturday Night Takeaway. Plus, the Supercomputer hits the road again and a member of the studio audience plays to win the contents of a commercial break

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The ultimate family entertainment show is back as Ant & Dec’s Saturday Night Takeaway returns to ITV, complete with big name showbiz guests, high octane stunts and challenges, ambitious undercover set ups and a whole host of live shocks and surprises to unleash upon both the studio audience and the viewers at home.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: This week Ant and Dec are joined by more special guests, including Gino D’Acampo in the first I’m a Celebrity Get Out of Me Ear! of the new series, Canadian rocker Bryan Adams who will do anything for you in Singalong Live!, and international pop princesses Little Mix who get wild in a special End of the Show Show. It’s the grand premiere of the mystery thriller that will have everyone asking Who Shot Simon Cowell?, there are some big surprises in store for the audience and another lucky player gets to Win the Ads in the only show that says don’t just watch the adverts - win ‘em!

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: This week Ant and Dec are joined by Hollywood superstar Kate Hudson as Guest Announcer and Bear Grylls gets the shock of his life as the boys go Undercover in total darkness! Plus Ant and Dec have enlisted the help of a pop sensation for the ultimate audience surprise. Ant and Dec will be singing for their lives with Stephen Mulhern by their side in Ant Vs Dec . And the plot thickens in the second instalment of Who Shot Simon Cowell? as David Walliams becomes the key suspect. Brit Award winning Jess Glynne will reach new heights in a spectacular End Of The Show Show! And the fickle finger of fate will select yet another lucky audience member to play Win the Ads in the only show that says don’t just watch the adverts - win ‘em!

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: This week the Geordie duo are joined by special guests including Mel B, who is sent barking mad as she interviews dog sitters in the next I’m a Celebrity… Get Out of Me Ear! Little Ant and Dec serve up their own unique brand of British humour as they meet Jennifer Lawrence and the stars of The Hunger Games, and UK garage legend Craig David joins Ant and Dec for an incredible End of the Show Show. The boys go head to head in the next instalment of Ant vs Dec and the Fickle Finger of Fate selects another lucky player to Win the Ads in the only show that says don’t just watch the adverts - win ‘em!

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview:
In his toughest role yet, Hollywood superhero Hugh Jackman is this week's guest announcer. He is joined by his Eddie the Eagle co-star Taron Egerton. Ant and Dec are still on the run in the penultimate episode of Who Shot Simon Cowell? but Dec discovers the real shooter. Peter Crouch and Abbey Clancy get into the party mood in  

'I’m a Celebrity…Get Out Of Me Ear! And in a spectacular, one night only West End showdown, the cast of two heavyweight musicals appear in The End of the Show Show. Plus the Fickle Finger of Fate will once again decide which audience member will play Win the Ads in the only show that says don’t just watch the adverts - win ‘em!

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: This week Ant & Dec are joined from a galaxy far, far away by Luke Skywalker himself, as Mark Hamill is this week’s guest announcer. Ant & Dec are still on the run in the 4th instalment of Who Shot Simon Cowell? As they manage to track down their prime suspect - Louis Walsh. Ant & Dec go head to head on mini-motorbikes in a madcap style race around the studio in Ant Vs Dec. And for one night only the cast of the West End musical Billy Elliot teach Little Ant & Dec to ballet dance in the cutest End of the Show Show EVER! And if that isn’t enough the Fickle Finger of Fate will be set on the loose to decide which lucky audience member will play Win the Ads in the only show that says don’t just watch the adverts - win ‘em!

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: It’s all aboard for the dazzling grand finale of the series, live from the deck of a cruise ship in Barcelona! It’s a suitably star-studded affair as star of stage and screen James Nesbitt takes the helm as the Guest Announcer, the UK’s greatest tennis player and Wimbledon legend Andy Murray meets cheeky Little Ant & Dec and 80’s pop sensation super hunk Peter Andre gets to Singalong Live with his classic Mysterious Girl. The truth finally comes out in the last thrilling installment of Who Shot Simon Cowell? and the boys do battle once again in Ant vs Dec - but who will beat The Cube to win the series?  There’s a huge surprise for one unsuspecting Cruise passenger and we round off the series with one of the most spectacular all-singing, all-dancing End Of The Show Shows that has ever been seen. All that plus one lucky audience member gets to find out what the Fickle Finger Of Fate has in store for them in the only show that says ‘Don’t just watch the adverts – Win ‘em!”
